newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Witwatersrand in deal with Derville.
newsitem.headline: Witwatersrand in deal with Derville.

text.p: South African mining group Witwatersrand Nigel Ltd said on Monday that it has agreed a deal with Derville Ltd that will see the overseas group inject two million rand cash into Phase 1 of its 11 Shaft project.

After the completion of the initial programme, and on the undertaking that Derville will continue exploring and spend a further 23 million rand, Witwatersrand will sell certain of its mining assets to a new company, Newco.
In a complex deal, the consideration for the sale will be 20 million rand in exchange for all the shares in and a loan account amounting to nine million rand against Newco.
Newco will then issue shares to Derville, in proportion to the amount spent on the exploration programme, with a maximum level of Derville holding 75 perent of Newco.
"The effect of the transaction is that Wit Nigel could dispose of up to 75 percent of the assets transferred to Newco for a consideration of 25 million rand," the firm said.
